artworks.name: hero_wide_v2
artworks.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create one ORIGINAL hand-painted fantasy landscape illustration, source art with NO TEXT. hero_wide variant 2. Extremely wide 3:1 panoramic image, 3072x1024 target.
Scene: a hopeful river valley at blue-hour dusk, rolling hills, misty blue-teal forests and violet-blue Shroud fog banked far at the horizon. MANY small cozy timber-and-stone bases dot the valley, each accompanied by its own golden-orange Flame Altar with subtle violet wisps. Depict at least sixteen separate altar fire points distributed over hills like a constellation, with winding footpaths and a river linking the homesteads. Nearest altars show low squat weathered grey-brown stone drums with dark side bands and brass top discs on wide round stone platforms engraved in concentric circles, supporting shallow bronze fire bowls with round openings. Emphasize warmth, belonging and the joy of building many bases.
Composition: fresh landscape viewed from a wooded ridge; quiet dark teal negative space covers the LEFT THIRD, gently graded mist behind it with no buildings there. Valley constellation of firelight unfolds across the remaining right two thirds, with cozy small houses in the midground. Keep all important houses and fires inside the middle 60 percent of the image HEIGHT for a future 4:1 banner crop. Distant soft mountains and muted mauve sunset, no oversized bright sun. Not a painting of a single village: many DISTINCT little homesteads separated by hills.
Style: stylized painterly game concept art with soft volumetric light, expressive brush shapes and beautiful atmospheric depth, based only on the look of the inspected game UI references. All paint, scenery and assets must be newly invented, never copy or paste the references.
No text, letters, runes, logos, UI, watermarks, brands, trademarks, characters, giant torches or photorealism.

artworks.name: hero_altar_v2
artworks.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Make an ORIGINAL 1024x1024 square painterly fantasy concept illustration with NO TEXT, hero_altar variant 2.
A single low and heavy Flame Altar in a mossy woodland clearing at twilight, with a few small homesteads and distant altar lights behind it. Depict the physical form using the inspected references only as look guidance: a SQUAT weathered grey-brown carved stone DRUM, slightly tapered, horizontal dark metal band, a round brass disc flush with the top. It stands on a broad circular stone platform with clean engraved concentric rings. A shallow ornate bronze brazier with ROUND openings holds the golden-orange Flame above the top. Flame's core is warm golden light, slender violet-purple wisps curl high from it, and embers rise. It must feel like a stone altar from a building game, not a large goblet.
Composition: whole altar and platform visible, from low three-quarter angle. Entire object including flame stays between y=12 and y=85 percent, centered x=55 percent; comfortable calm breathing room around all edges. A subtle glowing golden ring of light on the ground marks the claimed base. Several additional little altar flames glow in the distance among cozy timber and stone cottages. Misty blue-teal forest and a distant low violet fog bank. Strong readable stone silhouette, warm luminous flame, soft volumetric lighting, hopeful cozy-epic survival-crafting mood. Hand-painted texture with restrained color, richer dark teal shadows than variant 1.
Create a fresh scene and new painted elements. No copied reference pixels, no collage, no text, no letters, no numbers, no runes, no UI, no logos, no trademarks, no watermarks, no people, no giant staircase or tall pillar.

artworks.name: icon_altar
artworks.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. ORIGINAL clean centered readable square mod icon illustration, 1024x1024 target, with NO TEXT.
Subject: one recognizable Flame Altar. A very squat heavy weathered grey-brown stone drum with a dark band and a round brass disc at its top, standing on a wide circular stone platform with just two or three large engraved concentric rings. A low bronze brazier bowl with large circular openings sits above it, holding a bright warm golden-orange fire. Two bold violet-purple wisps curl upward from the golden core. The drum and ringed platform must be clearly visible, not hidden behind the flame or bowl. Use the inspected altar/flame references for basic form and materials ONLY; newly paint every element.
Composition: big bold simple silhouette, centered, entire flame and entire ringed platform inside frame with 10 percent margin. Total subject width around 75 percent of canvas, height around 80 percent. Icon remains immediately legible at 64 pixels: low detail, broad shapes, clear value hierarchy, no fine filigree or tiny features. A few bright embers at most. Background is a SIMPLE smooth DARK TEAL to INDIGO gradient, no scenery, no stars, no extra objects, no border. Soft warm ground halo.
Style: polished stylized painterly fantasy game item icon, crisp silhouette edges with hand-painted texture, strong warm/cool contrast. It should look like a cozy magical base altar, not a campfire, tall column, spiked chalice or modern stove.
Constraints: no text of any kind, no symbols, no logos, no trademarks, no UI, no watermark, no reference cutouts or copied reference pixels.
